task.title: Fix Annual Spend field missing from contact form
task.description:
The contact form (ctModal) is missing the annualSpend field which is used throughout priority scoring and AI generation. Add: (1) In the form-row containing ctInvoice, add a second input:
. (2) In saveContact(), add: annualSpend:parseFloat(document.getElementById('ctAnnual').value)||0. (3) In openEditContact(id), add: document.getElementById('ctAnnual').value=c.annualSpend||''. (4) In clearCtForm(), add ctAnnual to the array of fields reset to empty string. That is the complete fix — surgical, no other changes.

blocking_issues: No keyboard navigation support for modals - users cannot dismiss modals with ESC key or trap focus within modal
Missing ARIA labels on icon-only buttons (close button, logout button) making them inaccessible to screen readers
Form inputs lack proper error state announcements for screen readers - errors are visual only
No focus management when opening/closing modals - focus not returned to trigger element
Table rows marked 'clickable' have no keyboard interaction (Enter/Space) - mouse-only functionality
Guide modal has no mobile responsiveness - fixed positioning with 340px width will overflow on small screens (< 375px). Bottom: 90px and right: 28px positioning will cause issues on mobile devices.
Guide button and modal lack keyboard accessibility - no focus states, no ARIA labels, no keyboard navigation support (Tab, Escape to close). Modal can only be closed via mouse click.
Input field in guide has no associated label - 'guideInput' has placeholder but no <label> element, failing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements for form inputs.
